why: Many celebration items also thank helpers, and the scheme splits them by which strand holds more concepts.

why.T3-043: Thanking the negotiator and helpers for preserving the cube credits the defenders/helpers of the work.
why.T3-072: C1185629 specially thanks /r/SpaceX as an allied room for stabilising the cube.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-043 would not carry the thanks addressed to /r/SpaceX as an allied room that helped stabilise the cube.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1185629 explicitly thanks /r/SpaceX for stability, satisfying T3-072's gate of thanking another room for help.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-072; dropping it would lose the ally-specific thanks to /r/SpaceX.

why.T3-135: The banter plays the canvas/room conflict as Autobots and Decepticons, retelling it in the fandom's own faction terms.

why.T3-061: Concepts propose expanding the cube/name around Star Trek and downward, and assess capacity to expand aggressively into contested space.
why.T3-006: Concepts call for whiteout and a first offensive against neighbours, destroying/erasing rather than merely extending.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-061 would not carry the calls to white out/erase neighbours as clearing rather than occupying their space.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0133255 urges whiteout both so the cube cleans the place up, satisfying T3-006's gate of erasing another room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-006; dropping it would lose the clearing/erasure aim.

why.T3-005: Attack warnings, vandalism reports and all-hands calls to protect against named threats put it in defending the work against attackers.

why.T3-169: The item is about adding Team Cube signage, a nametag and the sub's name to the work.

why.T3-009: Concepts celebrate the little cube surviving and living on as an achieved finished work.

why.T3-010: Most concepts negotiate overlaps, compromises, equal yields and live-and-let-live space with neighbouring pictures.
why.T3-011: Some concepts redirect or offer help to another picture's work, such as saving van Gogh or helping build the TMNT piece.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 would not carry sending or offering help to another picture's work rather than settling borders with it.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1498658 redirects help to save van Gogh from the void, satisfying T3-011's gate of helping another room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-011; dropping it would lose the help-to-other-pictures strand.

why.T3-009: The dominant concepts mark the build as done with WE DID IT, GG and well done.
why.T3-043: One concept explicitly thanks everyone for their help, crediting the helpers.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 would not carry the explicit thanking of helpers after the build.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1258081 thanks everyone for their help, satisfying T3-043's gate of crediting helpers.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-043; dropping it would lose the thanks-to-helpers strand.

why.T3-041: Concepts add duplicate cubes, more Necker Cubes and new cube coordinates as extensions of the room's work.
why.T3-022: Concepts seek a new location after a flag devours the new cube or territory becomes too contested.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-041 would not carry relocating the cube after it was devoured or seeking a less territorial site.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0015261 proposes a new location after a flag devoured the new cube, satisfying T3-022's gate of moving after loss.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-022; dropping it would lose the after-loss relocation strand.

why.T3-151: The concepts trade defence, rebuilding and reciprocal help with neighbours, with the non-intrusion truce as background.

why.T3-101: Taking a moderator role and delegating/maintaining the cube's beauty is claiming stewardship and leadership of the work.

why.T3-037: The concept minimises the canvas as bragging rights and says not to take it seriously, judging its worth.

why.T3-169: The item is about Team Cube signage, a nametag and the sub's name on the work.

why.T3-005: Concepts warn of threats, call for defence, report losses and rally protectors against attackers.
why.T3-087: Concepts trace and name the attackers, including Kenya, the black bar and github bots.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 would not carry tracing and naming the attackers, including Kenya, the black bar and github bots.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0528063 and C0035492 name bots and Kenya as the source, satisfying T3-087's gate of tracing who changed the work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-087; dropping it would lose the attribution of the attacks.
